course.title: Complete AI Evaluation
course.subtitle: A structured path from LLM evaluation fundamentals to professional RAG, multimodal, safety, and agentic evaluation.
course.outcome: Understand, perform, analyze, and design complete AI evaluation workflows.

levels.title: LLM Evaluation Fundamentals
levels.description: Learn the foundations of evaluating language-model outputs and identifying core quality dimensions.

levels.title: Human Evaluation
levels.description: Learn how human evaluators use rubrics, scoring, comparison, calibration, and evidence-based judgment.

levels.title: Automated Evaluation
levels.description: Understand LLM-as-a-Judge systems and how to evaluate the reliability of automated evaluators.

levels.title: Metrics & Measurement
levels.description: Learn core classification metrics and how to interpret evaluation measurements.

levels.title: Factuality & Hallucination
levels.description: Learn how to identify unsupported, fabricated, and hallucinated information.

levels.title: Prompt & Instruction Evaluation
levels.description: Evaluate prompt robustness, instruction adherence, and behavioral stability.

levels.title: RAG Evaluation
levels.description: Evaluate retrieval, context quality, grounding, faithfulness, answer relevance, and complete RAG systems.

levels.title: AI Safety Evaluation
levels.description: Evaluate prompt injection resistance and the ability of AI systems to maintain safety boundaries.

levels.title: Multimodal Evaluation
levels.description: Evaluate systems that understand images and other modalities, including visual grounding and spatial localization.

levels.title: Conversational Evaluation
levels.description: Evaluate multi-turn context, consistency, memory, instruction persistence, and conversational behavior.

levels.title: Agentic Evaluation
levels.description: Evaluate agent planning, tool selection, tool arguments, trajectories, task completion, and recovery.

levels.title: Advanced Agentic Evaluation
levels.description: Evaluate agent safety, multi-agent coordination, and long-horizon reliability.

levels.title: Evaluation Engineering
levels.description: Build continuous evaluation systems, regression testing workflows, and complete evaluation frameworks.

lessons.title: What Is LLM Evaluation?
objectives: Understand why AI outputs require systematic evaluation
Identify the basic components of an evaluation
lessons.definition: LLM evaluation is the systematic process of measuring how well a language model performs a defined task against specific evaluation criteria.
lessons.whyItMatters: LLMs can produce fluent, convincing responses that are incorrect, incomplete, unsafe, or inconsistent. Evaluation provides a repeatable way to identify these failures.
lessons.concept: An evaluation normally contains a task, an input, a model output, evaluation criteria, evidence or reference information when required, and a judgment.

example.prompt: Explain why the sky appears blue.
example.response: The sky appears blue because Earth's atmosphere scatters shorter blue wavelengths of sunlight more strongly than longer wavelengths.
example.analysis: The evaluator checks factuality, relevance, completeness, clarity, and whether the response actually answers the question.

evaluationProcess: Define what the model is expected to do
Define the criteria used to judge the output
Collect evidence when factual verification is required
Assign a score or comparative judgment
Record the reason for the judgment
failureModes: Judging style instead of task success
Accepting fluent answers without checking factuality
evaluatorChecklist: Is the response actually answering the task?
Can another evaluator reproduce the judgment?
commonMistakes: Confusing good writing with a good answer
lessons.keyTakeaway: LLM evaluation is not simply deciding whether an answer feels good. It is a structured judgment against clearly defined criteria.
